flags.why: A learner today is most likely to encounter kết liễu meaning to kill or finish someone off.
Calling someone a fool or idiot is derogatory, and informal does not adequately warn the learner.
The common humorous meaning for someone exceptionally skilled or conspicuous at something, as in thánh soi, is missing ([usage examples](https://vtcnews.vn/tieu-diem/thanh-an.html)).
flags.fix: noun [slang, humorous] | someone exceptionally good at, or notorious for, something; ex: Cậu đúng là thánh đoán mò! = You're really a master of wild guesses!

flags.why: Chế meaning to pour liquid is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label.
